newsitem.title: USA: IPO PRICING - AutoBond Acceptance at $10.
newsitem.headline: IPO PRICING - AutoBond Acceptance at $10.

text.p: Shares of AutoBond Acceptance Corp were priced at $10 each for the company's initial public offering due later on Friday, according to its underwriter, the Boston Group.

A million shares were offered of the specialty consumer finance company, which underwrites retail installment and finance contracts originated by franchised automobile dealers. Of the million shares, 750,000 were offered by the company and 250,000 were offered by selling shareholders, according to a regulatory filing.
The shares priced at the bottom of the estimated filing range of $10 to $12. The Boston Group said it became the lead underwriter of the offering three weeks ago.

Austin, Texas-based Autobond originally filed in June for an offering of 1.975 million shares to price in a range of $11 to $13 with a different underwriter, Principal Securities. That offering was cut in subsequent filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission to 1.5 million shares to price in a range of $10 to $12.
The shares later opened for trading up 5/8 to 10-5/8.
